title: Add the support layer
goal: Refine your worksheet with small follow-ups — add real scaffolds and a true stretch.

blocks.title: The first draft is a starting point
blocks.body:
Your 3-tier worksheet is a good draft. Now make it yours — not by starting over, but with small, specific follow-ups.

The support tier is where a draft usually needs the most love. Ask for: "add sentence starters to tier 1", "put a worked example at the top of the support tier", "break question 3 into smaller steps". And push the top end: "make the stretch task ask them to explain their reasoning".

blocks.template: Your support tier is still too hard for the students who stall. The follow-up that helps most: {{move}}.

options: add sentence starters and one worked example to tier 1
add five more questions at the same difficulty
swap in longer, more advanced vocabulary

blocks.scaffold: Improve this — add sentence starters and a worked example to the support tier, and add a genuine extension task to the stretch tier that asks students to explain their reasoning.

blocks.question: How confident do you feel adding support and stretch to a draft now?
